description: SOC-thermal voltage model: V = OCV(SOC) - I*R(T), with Arrhenius resistance and capacity correction

cell.name: Generic NiMH AA cell (positive: NiOOH/Ni(OH)2; negative: AB5 metal hydride)
cell.source: Linden's Handbook of Batteries (4th ed., 2011), ch. 31; Panasonic NiMH datasheets

ocv_coefficients.description: OCV(SOC) = a0 + a1*SOC + a2*SOC^2 + a3*SOC^3 + a4*SOC^4 + a5*SOC^5
ocv_coefficients.source: Polynomial fit to representative NiMH discharge curve (~1.2 V plateau)

E_a.note: Activation energy for NiMH internal resistance; proton-conducting NiOOH cathode kinetics
E_a.source: Khun et al. (2006), Electrochimica Acta 51, 2877; Linden's Handbook ch. 31

alpha_c.note: NiMH capacity is notably temperature-sensitive; capacity at -20C ~ 60% of 25C value

dOCV_dT.note: Entropic coefficient for NiMH is positive (exothermic charging) unlike Li-ion which is negative

temperature.note: -20 to 60 degC; NiMH operates over wide temperature range
